## Documentation

A text fixed with [`fix_text_with_ai`](../../methods/messages/fix_text_with_ai.md).

### Parameters

- **`text`** ([`FormattedText`](FormattedText.md))
  The fixed text.

- **`diff_text`** ([`FormattedText`](FormattedText.md), *optional*)
  The changes made to the original text: a text whose entities, of type
  `DIFF_INSERT`, `DIFF_REPLACE`
  (with the replaced text in *old_text*) and `DIFF_DELETE`,
  mark the inserted, replaced and deleted parts.
